answer: Sybil resistance follows because EigenTrust-style centrality propagates through reciprocal, weighted endorsements, while reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life. A fresh identity cannot gain influence simply by appearing in an orchard, an oasis, or an ocean of peers: it starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality and must earn trust through sustained honest service. Without that history and corroboration, it cannot pass consensus.
